summary.zh: 用 STRIDE 方法系统梳理系统威胁
summary.en: Apply STRIDE to systematically identify system threats.

description.zh: 按 STRIDE 的六个维度对系统架构逐项提问，产出可评审的威胁清单和安全文档素材。适合安全评审、架构设计，以及需要向团队讲清风险来源的场合。
description.en: Walks a system architecture through the six STRIDE categories to produce a reviewable threat list and security write-up. Good for security reviews, design sessions, and explaining where risks come from.
